_schema.about: Declarative position-based task rules for the T-maze rig. Edit this file to add/tune rules without touching Python. Loaded by host/rules_view.py; evaluated by host/rules_engine.py. See docs/decisions/0023 and 0026. Distances (radius_cm) are in CENTIMETERS and converted to pixels via host/rig_scale.json (Rules tab 'Measure scale'). Zone/loop templates instead use the maze zone map host/zones.json (Tracking tab) via the maze-state estimator - no cm scale needed.

layout.flat: A top-level 'rules' list (legacy): one active rule set.
layout.profiles: A 'profiles' map of named phases; 'active_profile' selects the default; the Rules tab exposes a Phase dropdown to switch. Each profile has a 'label', an optional 'defaults' override, and its own 'rules' list.

defaults.min_confidence: 0..1; only act while the track is TRACKING with confidence >= this
defaults.topup_cooldown_ms: minimum ms between fires WITHIN a visit (prime->top-up, top-up->top-up); keep short
defaults.rearm_refractory_ms: prime_and_lick_topup only: anti-camp timer before the rule may PRIME again on a fresh visit
defaults.global_min_interval_ms: runaway backstop: minimum ms between ANY two fires across all rules

rule_fields.enabled: true/false; disable a rule without deleting it
rule_fields.max_topups: max lick-triggered top-ups per visit (after the prime)
rule_fields.lick_debounce_ms: ignore lick edges closer together than this (ms) - anti-chatter only
rule_fields.topup_cooldown_ms: override the default within-visit top-up cooldown (ms)
rule_fields.min_confidence: override the default min track confidence
rule_fields.landmark: prime_and_lick_topup: {kind, index} of the annotated point (well 0=left,1=right,2=center)
rule_fields.radius_cm: prime_and_lick_topup: proximity RADIUS in cm around the landmark
rule_fields.rearm_on_exit: prime_and_lick_topup: re-arm once the animal leaves the zone
rule_fields.credential: well_reward_with_excursion: which excursion earns the next well payout - 'choice' (enter either choice arm), 'choice_via_stem' (enter a choice arm, outbound leg used the central stem), or 'clean_loop' (a completed clean lap: stem out + matching return arm)
rule_fields.nonstem_reward_prob: well_reward_with_excursion ('choice' credential only): probability 0..1 that a NON-stem excursion earns a credit (stem excursions always do). 1.0 = Phase 1 (any choice); 0.0 = exactly Phase 2a (stem-only). Lower it across sessions to fade Phase 1 into 2a without an extinction cliff (see ADR-0028); settable live in the Rules tab's Shaping control. Default 1.0.
rule_fields.seed: well_reward_with_excursion (optional): RNG seed for the non-stem fade roll and the debias cap draw, for reproducibility
rule_fields.prime_on: well_reward_with_excursion: when/where the prime fires - 'well_arrival' (on reaching the well while credited; default), 'well_lick' (first lick at the well fires the prime; lick-gated), or 'credential' (fire the instant the credential is earned, out at the choice zone, so the central-spout solenoid is the correct-choice signal; used by Phase 2a/2b - see ADR-0030). Legacy 'prime_on_arrival' (true/false) still accepted as an alias for well_arrival/well_lick.
rule_fields.debias: well_reward_with_excursion (clean_loop or choice_via_stem): anti-bias cap on the same-side run - {mode:'fixed', n:3} or {mode:'uniform', min:3, max:5, seed:optional}. clean_loop caps consecutive same-side loops; choice_via_stem caps consecutive same-side stem-gated choice entries. A run beyond the cap is logged (debias_withhold) but WITHHELD, nudging the animal to the other side. Omit for no cap.

templates.prime_and_lick_topup: On entering the zone (confident track within radius_cm of landmark): dispense once (prime), then each subsequent lick tops up up to max_topups. Re-prime requires leaving the zone AND waiting rearm_refractory_ms.
templates.well_reward_with_excursion: Reward at the central well (port 2) is credentialed by a behavioral excursion (see 'credential'). The prime consumes the credit, so each payout needs a fresh excursion. Licks top up as in prime_and_lick_topup. The reward-shaping curriculum: Phase 1 = 'choice' (prime_on well_arrival), Phase 2a = 'choice_via_stem', Phase 2b = 'choice_via_stem' + 'debias' (choice-side anti-bias); 2a/2b use prime_on 'credential' so the prime fires the moment the animal enters a choice arm (solenoid = correct-choice signal). Phase 1 -> 2a can be a gradual fade via 'nonstem_reward_prob' (1.0 -> 0.0). Requires zones.json.

phase2b.label: Phase 2b - stem-gated choice + anti-bias (prime at choice)
